Estimates catch up when you reopen this page. Notifications require permission and a visible page; no alerts are guaranteed while backgrounded or closed.

Open the charging timer to review the estimate. Check your vehicle for its actual charge.
Timer storage failed. This action is not confirmed. Close other tabs and reload storage; saved timestamps will catch up. Do not clear site data.
Data stays in this browser on this site. Clearing site data or leaving private browsing can erase it. Export a backup and keep the unencrypted file somewhere private.
Storage or file operation failed. Your action was not confirmed. Close other tabs and retry; do not clear site data. Check browser download permissions if exporting.
Download requested. Check your browser downloads to confirm the file was saved.

This backup contains %1$d presets and %2$d history entries. It will replace all presets, preferences and history in this browser. Unfinished imported sessions become interrupted history, never running timers.
